critical_code_review_comments: Fix #1 (api.js): correct minimal fix. Guarding on the exact boolean discriminator (`payload.meta === true`) is the right shape — the two same-named fields are semantically unrelated (a mid-stream boolean flag vs a terminal quota/CTA hint object) and colliding them via truthiness was the exact bug. Non-invasive and self-documenting via inline comment.

Fix #2 (local_tools.py): the layered budget design (inner snapshot cap + outer total cap, both < orchestrator's 45s outer safety net) is sound and correctly acknowledges httpx `read` timeout's known limitation (bounds inter-chunk time, not total transfer). The constants are module-level so tests can shrink them for deterministic ms-level runs, which is the correct testability pattern.

Known infra limitation NOT fixed in-code (explicitly per request): ~60s Cloudflare/GCLB SSE buffer & total-response cap on the preview URL. Correctly escalated via support_agent to support@emergent.sh. No app-code change appropriate here; document in known-limitations.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes are landed and unit-test-verified. If a future session needs to reproduce the button-stuck bug: use the exact SSE frame sequence in streamChat.doneMetaCollision.test.js (a done frame carrying `meta: {}` alongside `done: true`). If reproducing the search_repo hang: point at project_id p_64987820ec (polarisbuiltinc-wq/Aurem-1) which has the 264MB tarball. The Cloudflare/GCLB ~60s external SSE cap on the preview URL is a real, already-escalated infra constraint — complex multi-step agent turns that legitimately need >55s can still die with zero bytes to the external client; this is NOT a new backend/frontend bug. Backend `via: 1.1 google` header + stripped X-Accel-Buffering is the diagnostic signature.
rca of the issue: Bug #1 (button stuck): SSE dispatcher used exclusive if/else-if keyed on field PRESENCE (`if (payload.meta) ...`). Backend `done` frames carry an independent nested `meta` object (quota/upgrade CTA hints, often `{}`); empty object is truthy in JS so `onMeta` matched first and `onDone` never fired → busy/streaming flag never reset → send button stuck on 'Thinking…' until 90s watchdog. Reproduction: SSE frame `{done:true, meta:{}, ...}` post-tokens. Mitigation: exact boolean match `payload.meta === true`. Bug #2 (search_repo hang): httpx `read` timeout only bounds INTER-chunk time, not total transfer duration. For repos with a slow/huge (264MB in the founder's Aurem-1 repo, from a 201MB stray .agent dir) but steadily-streaming tarball, snapshot download exceeded the orchestrator's 45s per-tool outer cap and was externally killed. Cache marker is only written on successful extract, so the failure repeated identically every call. Mitigation: internal snapshot budget (_SEARCH_REPO_SNAPSHOT_BUDGET_S=8s) and total-function budget (_SEARCH_REPO_TOTAL_BUDGET_S=20s), both well under the 45s outer cap, allowing graceful fall-through to the budgeted GitHub API fallback.
